001package org.clafer.choco.constraint.propagator;
002
003import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.Propagator;
004import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.PropagatorPriority;
005import org.chocosolver.solver.exception.ContradictionException;
006import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.IntVar;
007import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.SetVar;
008import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.Variable;
009import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.delta.IIntDeltaMonitor;
010import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.delta.ISetDeltaMonitor;
011import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.events.IntEventType;
012import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.events.SetEventType;
013import org.chocosolver.util.ESat;
014import org.chocosolver.util.procedure.IntProcedure;
015
016/**
017 * if i = filter then s = {} else s = {i}
018 *
019 * @author jimmy
020 */
021public class PropSingletonFilter extends Propagator<Variable> {
022
023    private final IntVar i;
024    private final IIntDeltaMonitor iD;
025    private final SetVar s;
026    private final ISetDeltaMonitor sD;
027    private final int filter;
028
029    public PropSingletonFilter(IntVar ivar, SetVar svar, int filter) {
030        super(new Variable[]{ivar, svar}, PropagatorPriority.UNARY, true);
031        this.i = ivar;
032        this.iD = i.monitorDelta(this);
033        this.s = svar;
034        this.sD = s.monitorDelta(this);
035        this.filter = filter;
036    }
037
038    private boolean isIVar(int idx) {
039        return idx == 0;
040    }
041
042    private boolean isSVar(int idx) {
043        return idx == 1;
044    }
045
046    @Override
047    public int getPropagationConditions(int vIdx) {
048        if (isIVar(vIdx)) {
049            return IntEventType.all();
050        }
051        assert isSVar(vIdx);
052        return SetEventType.all();
053    }
054
055    @Override
056    public void propagate(int evtmask) throws ContradictionException {
057        s.remove(filter, this);
058        if (s.getLB().size() > 1) {
059            fails();
060        } else if (s.getLB().size() == 1) {
061            int val = s.getLB().min();
062            i.instantiateTo(val, this);
063            s.instantiateTo(new int[]{val}, this);
064        } else {
065            int ub = i.getUB();
066            for (int val = i.getLB(); val <= ub; val = i.nextValue(val)) {
067                if (val != filter && !s.getUB().contains(val)) {
068                    i.removeValue(val, this);
069                }
070            }
071            PropUtil.envSubsetDom(s, i, this);
072            if (i.isInstantiated()) {
073                int val = i.getValue();
074                s.instantiateTo(val == filter ? new int[]{} : new int[]{val}, this);
075            }
076        }
077        iD.startMonitoring();
078        sD.startMonitoring();
079    }
080
081    @Override
082    public void propagate(int idxVarInProp, int mask) throws ContradictionException {
083        if (isIVar(idxVarInProp)) {
084            if (i.isInstantiated()) {
085                int val = i.getValue();
086                s.instantiateTo(val == filter ? new int[]{} : new int[]{val}, this);
087            } else {
088                iD.forEachRemVal((IntProcedure) rem -> s.remove(rem, this));
089            }
090        } else {
091            assert isSVar(idxVarInProp);
092            int sKerSize = s.getLB().size();
093            if (sKerSize > 1) {
094                fails();
095            } else if (sKerSize == 1) {
096                int val = s.getLB().min();
097                i.instantiateTo(val, this);
098                s.instantiateTo(new int[]{val}, this);
099            } else {
100                sD.forEach((IntProcedure) env -> {
101                    if (env != filter) {
102                        i.removeValue(env, this);
103                    }
104                }, SetEventType.REMOVE_FROM_ENVELOPE);
105                if (i.isInstantiated()) {
106                    int val = i.getValue();
107                    s.instantiateTo(val == filter ? new int[]{} : new int[]{val}, this);
108                }
109            }
110        }
111    }
112
113    @Override
114    public ESat isEntailed() {
115        return ESat.UNDEFINED;
116    }
117
118    @Override
119    public String toString() {
120        return "singletonFilter" + filter + "({" + i + "} = " + s + ", " + s.getCard() + ")";
121    }
122}
